messages:
Nina: FYI saw missing KMS decrypt audit entries during a nightly image-sign run (~2026-02-10 02:40-03:10 UTC). Cosign logged success but cloudkms shows a gap.
Sam: Which key?
Nina: projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/sign-key.
security-bot: [alert] 2026-02-10T02:49Z COSIGN_AUDIT_MISSING principal=signer-service
Maya: Likely IAM drift or infra-iam-runner retry failure. Treat as ACL misconfig first.
Priya: I recently added ci-temp@redwood to unblock a job. That account should've been removed.
Devon: Immediate actions: 1) snapshot key policy 2) export cloudkms audit logs 3) remove ci-temp if present 4) prep key rotation plan.
Sam: Dumping policy: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/images/cryptoKeys/sign-key --format=json`
Sam: sanitized bindings show `ci-temp@redwood` present under encrypter/decrypter.
Nina: Remove it now, wait 5m, then rotate. Keep rollback steps if build breaks.
Priya: Removing binding via infra-iam PR. I will also create a logging sink to gs://redwood-forensics/kms-20260210.
security-bot: [info] 2026-02-10T03:02Z IAM_CHANGE queued by infra-automation
Sam: IAM change applied 2026-02-10T03:05Z. Starting key rotation and updating cosign wrapper to point at new key version.
Maya: After rotation, verify decrypt logs show signer-service entries. If only expected principals appear, proceed with small canary (5 images), then 25, then full.
Devon: Filed INC-2026-0123 (sev2). Forensics note: preserve images, logs, and builder-run metadata.
Nina: Postmortem owners: Maya (lead), Priya (infra fix), Sam (cosign tracing). Add TRACE_ID tracing in cosign wrapper to correlate builds -> KMS calls.
security-bot: [resolve] 2026-02-10T04:30Z CANARY_COMPLETE status=ok
Nina: Closing thread; will reopen if anomalies during roll. Thanks team.
